reviews.title: Not The Best
reviews.comment: Had to buy and return twice - will not be purchasing this product again. Where it plugs in seems to be super fragile - my first one, the screen would go on and off all the time, assuming because there wasn't a good connection into the USB drive. My second one, the connector just broke off after using for a month. Pretty disappointing for a close to $400 product..
